text:
Amelia: Thinking about a tiny handheld showdown this Friday? Steam Deck vs Switch vs handheld indies. Low-key tournament + couch space? :game_die:
Dario: love this. I can bring my Deck (OLED) and a few co-op indie picks. What time?
Amelia: 7pm start? gives people time after work.
Santiago: I'm in if there's power strips. My Switch has low battery 90% of the time :sweat_smile:
Jules: I have a 6-port Anker charger and a USB-C hub/dock I can bring. Also a couple of spare USB-C -> USB-A cables.
Amelia: perfect. anyone got a portable projector or big screen?
Dario: can bring a 1080p pico. FYI it needs HDMI and a small speaker if we want louder audio.
Santiago: can we do a tiny poll for games? reply with emoji: :steamdeck: = Deck-only indies, :nintendo: = Smash/party on Switch, :joystick: = local co-op PC/handheld ports
Jules: :steamdeck:
Amelia: :nintendo: (but i'm game for both)
Dario: :steamdeck: + also down for 2v2 on Switch later
ops-bot: Room reservation confirmed: Room A (Lounge) 18:45–22:30 on 2026-03-27. Organizer: Amelia.
Santiago: sweet. can someone bring a short ethernet cable? LAN is nicer for stable Parsec/remote play sessions.
Jules: i can bring a 2m cable and an extra travel router if needed.
Amelia: OK signups: say what you're bringing. I'll try to organize brackets (very casual).
Dario: Bringing: Steam Deck (OLED), pico projector, HDMI cable, Dock-ish hub
Jules: Bringing: 6-port charger, USB cables, 2m ethernet, travel router
Santiago: Bringing: Switch Lite + Pro controller, spare Joy-Con pair
Amelia: Bringing: snacks, extension cord, fold-out couch pad. I'll post a tiny schedule later.
Dario: quick tech note — if anyone wants to test bandwidth beforehand run:
```
# on host (server)
iperf3 -s
# on client
iperf3 -c 10.0.0.5 -P 4
```
Jules: thanks for that. also bring earbuds for late sessions pls :grimacing:
Amelia: cool. i'll make a thread with the bracket sign-up tomorrow and a poll for final game choices. winners get glory and maybe a sticker pack :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: 
Santiago: count me in. thanks for organizing!
Dario: stoked. see y'all friday :party_parrot:
